Labeled Schedule N table for inspection

Source: R/inspect.R
sn_labeled.Rd

Stacks Schedule N Part I and Part II asset lines into one tidy table: one row per asset line, with the part's checkbox answers as extra columns, the filing's classifier label and key evidence, and a flag on the line(s) that go to the merger recipient. A filing part with a header but no asset lines gets one row with empty asset fields, so every labeled filing appears.

Usage

sn_labeled(
  sn,
  labeled,
  cases = NULL,
  transactions = NULL,
  label_cols = c("TYPE", "BASIS", "AFFILIATED", "TERMINATED", "FINAL_RETURN", "LEADER",
    "LEADER_SN", "LEADER_P7", "SN_MERGER_TEXT", "N_CORROBORATE", "N_NP_RECIP",
    "TOP_SHARE", "FMV_TOTAL", "N_DONORS", "R_NEW")
)

Arguments

sn

An sn_raw object from get_schedule_n().

labeled

The labeled filing table, sched_n_table() (the sched_n element of build_merger_data()).

cases

Optional merger cases from build_merger_cases() (the cases element). Used to name the merger recipient of each donor filing.

transactions

Optional asset lines with recovered recipient EINs (the transactions element). Used when its rows line up with sn_transactions(sn); otherwise only reported EINs are used.

label_cols

Columns of labeled to carry onto every row.

Value

A data.table with filing columns (OBJECTID, EIN2, ORG_NAME, TAX_YEAR, TAX_PERIOD_END, URL, the label_cols, MERGER_ID, MERGER_RECIP_EIN2, HAS_RECIPIENT_ROW, P3_TEXT), line columns (PART, LINE, ASSET_DESC, DIST_DATE, FMV, FMV_METHOD, RECIP_EIN2, EIN_SOURCE, RECIP_NAME, RECIP_CITY, RECIP_STATE, RECIP_ZIP, IRC_SECTION, RECIP_TYPE, SELF_TRANSFER, IS_MERGER_RECIPIENT), and the checkbox columns in sn_checkboxes() (NA where the part does not ask the question).

See also

sn_inspection() to draw review samples.
